Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

  - `sku`: string (required) — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer (required) — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]

- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### POST /addresses

Create a address

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer
- `line1`: string (required) — Street address
- `city`: string (required) — City
- `postal_code`: string (required) — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address

- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

Get a address by ID

- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `state`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

### POST /orders

Create an order

Creates an order for a customer. Every SKU must exist in the product catalog; prices are taken from the catalog.

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — ID of an existing customer (look it up by email first)
- `line_items`: array of object (required)
  - `sku`: string (required) — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer (required) — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`

Response:

- `customer_id`: integer

- `items`: array of object

  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### POST /addresses

Create a address

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer
- `line1`: string (required) — Street address
- `city`: string (required) — City
- `postal_code`: string (required) — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /addresses/{address_id}

Get a address by ID

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### PATCH /addresses/{address_id}

Update a address

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /coupons

List coupons

Discount coupons. Optionally filter by `code`.

Parameters:
- `code`: string — Coupon code (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### POST /coupons

Create a coupon

Request body (JSON):
- `code`: string (required) — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer (required) — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string (required) — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean (required) — Can still be redeemed

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### GET /coupons/{coupon_id}

Get a coupon by ID

Parameters:
- `coupon_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### PATCH /coupons/{coupon_id}

Update a coupon

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Parameters:
- `coupon_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Request body (JSON):
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

Response:

- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### GET /customers

Find customers

List customers, optionally filtered by exact email address.

Parameters:
- `email`: string — Exact email to match (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `name`: string
- `email`: string

### GET /customers/{customer_id}

Get a customer by ID

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `name`: string
- `email`: string

### GET /invoices

List invoices

Invoices issued for orders. Optionally filter by `order_id`.

Parameters:
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `paid`: boolean — Whether the invoice has been settled

### POST /invoices

Create a invoice

Request body (JSON):
- `order_id`: integer (required) — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number (required) — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string (required) — ISO timestamp
- `paid`: boolean (required) — Whether the invoice has been settled

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string — ISO timestamp

### GET /invoices/{invoice_id}

Get a invoice by ID

Parameters:

Response:

- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `paid`: boolean — Whether the invoice has been settled

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

### POST /orders

Create an order

Creates an order for a customer. Every SKU must exist in the product catalog; prices are taken from the catalog.

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — ID of an existing customer (look it up by email first)
- `items`: array of object (required)
  - `sku`: string (required) — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer (required) — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

### GET /orders/{order_id}

Get an order by ID

Parameters:
- `order_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

### PATCH /orders/{order_id}

Update an order's status

Changes the status of an order. Fails with 409 if the order is already shipped or cancelled.

Parameters:

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### POST /addresses

Create a address

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer
- `line1`: string (required) — Street address
- `city`: string (required) — City
- `postal_code`: string (required) — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /addresses/{address_id}

Get a address by ID

Parameters:

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object

    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer

- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

- `customer_id`: integer

- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### POST /addresses

Create a address

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer
- `line1`: string (required) — Street address
- `city`: string (required) — City
- `postal_code`: string (required) — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /addresses/{address_id}

Get a address by ID

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### PATCH /addresses/{address_id}

Update a address

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /coupons

List coupons

Discount coupons. Optionally filter by `code`.

Parameters:
- `code`: string — Coupon code (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### POST /coupons

Create a coupon

Request body (JSON):
- `code`: string (required) — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer (required) — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string (required) — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean (required) — Can still be redeemed

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### GET /coupons/{coupon_id}

Get a coupon by ID

Parameters:
- `coupon_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer

Partial update; only provided fields change.

- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

Find customers

List customers, optionally filtered by exact email address.

Parameters:
- `email`: string — Exact email to match (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `name`: string
- `email`: string

### GET /customers/{customer_id}

Get a customer by ID

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer

- `email`: string

List invoices

Invoices issued for orders. Optionally filter by `order_id`.

Parameters:
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `paid`: boolean — Whether the invoice has been settled

### POST /invoices

Create a invoice

- `order_id`: integer (required) — Order being invoiced

- `paid`: boolean (required) — Whether the invoice has been settled

Response:

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

### POST /orders

Create an order

Creates an order for a customer. Every SKU must exist in the product catalog; prices are taken from the catalog.

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — ID of an existing customer (look it up by email first)
- `items`: array of object (required)
  - `sku`: string (required) — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer (required) — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

### PATCH /orders/{order_id}

Changes the status of an order. Fails with 409 if the order is already shipped or cancelled.

Parameters:

Request body (JSON):

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

  - `items`: array of object

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### POST /addresses

Create a address

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer
- `line1`: string (required) — Street address
- `city`: string (required) — City
- `postal_code`: string (required) — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /addresses/{address_id}

Get a address by ID

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### PATCH /addresses/{address_id}

Update a address

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /coupons

List coupons

Discount coupons. Optionally filter by `code`.

Parameters:
- `code`: string — Coupon code (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### POST /coupons

Create a coupon

Request body (JSON):
- `code`: string (required) — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer (required) — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string (required) — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean (required) — Can still be redeemed

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### GET /coupons/{coupon_id}

Get a coupon by ID

Parameters:
- `coupon_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### PATCH /coupons/{coupon_id}

Update a coupon

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Parameters:
- `coupon_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Request body (JSON):
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### GET /customers

Find customers

List customers, optionally filtered by exact email address.

Parameters:
- `email`: string — Exact email to match (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `name`: string
- `email`: string

### GET /customers/{customer_id}

Get a customer by ID

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `name`: string
- `email`: string

### GET /invoices

List invoices

Invoices issued for orders. Optionally filter by `order_id`.

Parameters:
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `paid`: boolean — Whether the invoice has been settled

### POST /invoices

Create a invoice

Request body (JSON):
- `order_id`: integer (required) — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number (required) — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string (required) — ISO timestamp
- `paid`: boolean (required) — Whether the invoice has been settled

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `paid`: boolean — Whether the invoice has been settled

### GET /invoices/{invoice_id}

Get a invoice by ID

Parameters:
- `invoice_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `paid`: boolean — Whether the invoice has been settled

### PATCH /invoices/{invoice_id}

Update a invoice

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Parameters:
- `invoice_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Request body (JSON):
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `paid`: boolean — Whether the invoice has been settled

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `paid`: boolean — Whether the invoice has been settled

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

### POST /orders

Create an order

Creates an order for a customer. Every SKU must exist in the product catalog; prices are taken from the catalog.

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — ID of an existing customer (look it up by email first)
- `items`: array of object (required)
  - `sku`: string (required) — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer (required) — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

### GET /orders/{order_id}

Get an order by ID

Parameters:
- `order_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

### PATCH /orders/{order_id}

Update an order's status

Changes the status of an order. Fails with 409 if the order is already shipped or cancelled.

Parameters:
- `order_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Request body (JSON):
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` (required)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

### GET /payments

List payments

Payment captures against orders. Optionally filter by `order_id`.

Parameters:
- `order_id`: integer — Order being paid (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being paid
- `method`: string — card | bank | wallet
- `amount`: number — Captured amount
- `captured_at`: string — ISO timestamp

### POST /payments

Create a payment

Request body (JSON):
- `order_id`: integer (required) — Order being paid
- `method`: string (required) — card | bank | wallet
- `amount`: number (required) — Captured amount
- `captured_at`: string (required) — ISO timestamp

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being paid
- `method`: string — card | bank | wallet
- `amount`: number — Captured amount
- `captured_at`: string — ISO timestamp

### GET /payments/{payment_id}

Get a payment by ID

Parameters:
- `payment_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being paid
- `method`: string — card | bank | wallet
- `amount`: number — Captured amount
- `captured_at`: string — ISO timestamp

### PATCH /payments/{payment_id}

Update a payment

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Parameters:
- `payment_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Request body (JSON):
- `order_id`: integer — Order being paid
- `method`: string — card | bank | wallet
- `amount`: number — Captured amount
- `captured_at`: string — ISO timestamp

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being paid
- `method`: string — card | bank | wallet
- `amount`: number — Captured amount
- `captured_at`: string — ISO timestamp

### GET /products

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object

    - `unit_price`: number

  - `created_at`: string

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer

- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

- `items`: array of object (required)
  - `sku`: string (required) — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer (required) — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `state`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `state`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### POST /addresses

Create a address

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer
- `line1`: string (required) — Street address
- `city`: string (required) — City
- `postal_code`: string (required) — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /addresses/{address_id}

Get a address by ID

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

Update a address

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Request body (JSON):

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `state`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

### POST /orders

Create an order

Creates an order for a customer. Every SKU must exist in the product catalog; prices are taken from the catalog.

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — ID of an existing customer (look it up by email first)
- `line_items`: array of object (required)
  - `sku`: string (required) — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer (required) — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### POST /addresses

Create a address

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer
- `line1`: string (required) — Street address
- `city`: string (required) — City
- `postal_code`: string (required) — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /addresses/{address_id}

Get a address by ID

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### PATCH /addresses/{address_id}

Update a address

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /coupons

List coupons

Discount coupons. Optionally filter by `code`.

Parameters:
- `code`: string — Coupon code (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### POST /coupons

Create a coupon

Request body (JSON):
- `code`: string (required) — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer (required) — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string (required) — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean (required) — Can still be redeemed

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### GET /coupons/{coupon_id}

Get a coupon by ID

Parameters:
- `coupon_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### PATCH /coupons/{coupon_id}

Update a coupon

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Request body (JSON):

- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

Find customers

List customers, optionally filtered by exact email address.

Parameters:
- `customer_email`: string — Exact email to match (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `name`: string
- `email`: string

### GET /customers/{customer_id}

Get a customer by ID

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer

- `email`: string

List invoices

Invoices issued for orders. Optionally filter by `order_id`.

Parameters:
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `order_id`: integer — Order being invoiced
- `amount`: number — Invoiced amount
- `issued_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `paid`: boolean — Whether the invoice has been settled

### POST /invoices

Create a invoice

Request body (JSON):

- `paid`: boolean (required) — Whether the invoice has been settled

Response:

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `state`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

### POST /orders

Create an order

Creates an order for a customer. Every SKU must exist in the product catalog; prices are taken from the catalog.

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — ID of an existing customer (look it up by email first)
- `line_items`: array of object (required)
  - `sku`: string (required) — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer (required) — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

Get an order by ID

Parameters:

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

### PATCH /orders/{order_id}

Update an order's status

Changes the status of an order. Fails with 409 if the order is already shipped or cancelled.

Parameters:
- `order_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Request body (JSON):
- `new_status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` (required)

  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### POST /addresses

Create a address

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer
- `line1`: string (required) — Street address
- `city`: string (required) — City
- `postal_code`: string (required) — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /addresses/{address_id}

Get a address by ID

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### PATCH /addresses/{address_id}

Update a address

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /coupons

List coupons

Discount coupons. Optionally filter by `code`.

Parameters:
- `code`: string — Coupon code (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### POST /coupons

Create a coupon

Request body (JSON):
- `code`: string (required) — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer (required) — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string (required) — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean (required) — Can still be redeemed

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

Parameters:

List invoices

Invoices issued for orders. Optionally filter by `order_id`.

Parameters:

Response: array of objects:

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### POST /addresses

Create a address

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer
- `line1`: string (required) — Street address
- `city`: string (required) — City
- `postal_code`: string (required) — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog

    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

# OrderHub API v1.0

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### POST /addresses

Create a address

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer
- `line1`: string (required) — Street address
- `city`: string (required) — City
- `postal_code`: string (required) — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

Get a address by ID

- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address

- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address

- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /coupons

List coupons

Discount coupons. Optionally filter by `code`.

Parameters:

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### POST /coupons

Create a coupon

- `percent_off`: integer (required) — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string (required) — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean (required) — Can still be redeemed

- `code`: string — Coupon code

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `state`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

Creates an order for a customer. Every SKU must exist in the product catalog; prices are taken from the catalog.

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — ID of an existing customer (look it up by email first)
- `line_items`: array of object (required)

- `created_at`: string

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### POST /addresses

Create a address

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer
- `line1`: string (required) — Street address
- `city`: string (required) — City
- `postal_code`: string (required) — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### GET /addresses/{address_id}

Get a address by ID

Parameters:
- `address_id`: integer (required) (in path)

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

### PATCH /addresses/{address_id}

Update a address

Partial update; only provided fields change.

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer

### GET /coupons

List coupons

Discount coupons. Optionally filter by `code`.

Parameters:
- `code`: string — Coupon code (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `code`: string — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer — Discount percentage
- `expires_at`: string — ISO timestamp
- `active`: boolean — Can still be redeemed

### POST /coupons

Create a coupon

Request body (JSON):
- `code`: string (required) — Coupon code
- `percent_off`: integer (required) — Discount percentage

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `state`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

### POST /orders

Create an order

Creates an order for a customer. Every SKU must exist in the product catalog; prices are taken from the catalog.

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — ID of an existing customer (look it up by email first)
- `line_items`: array of object (required)
  - `sku`: string (required) — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer (required) — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

Get an order by ID

Parameters:

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

### PATCH /orders/{order_id}

Update an order's status

Changes the status of an order. Fails with 409 if the order is already shipped or cancelled.

Parameters:

- `new_status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` (required)

### GET /orders

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `state`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

# OrderHub API v1.0

- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

# API documentation

# OrderHub API v1.0

Order management API. All requests require header `X-API-Key`. The API may respond 429 with a `Retry-After` header; wait and retry the same request.

Base URL: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`. Header `X-API-Key: test-key` is required on every request. Request and response bodies are JSON. Validation errors return 422 with a `detail` field explaining the problem.

## Endpoints

### GET /addresses

List addresses

Customer shipping addresses. Optionally filter by `customer_id`.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer (in query)

Response: array of objects:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer — Owning customer
- `line1`: string — Street address
- `city`: string — City
- `postal_code`: string — Postal code
- `is_default`: boolean — Default shipping address

- `customer_id`: integer (required) — Owning customer

- `is_default`: boolean (required) — Default shipping address

Get a address by ID

### GET /orders

List orders (paginated)

Cursor-paginated. Results are limited to `limit` per page; follow `next_cursor` until it is null to see all matching orders.

Parameters:
- `customer_id`: integer — Only orders of this customer (in query)
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled` — Only orders in this status (in query)
- `cursor`: string — Cursor from a previous page (in query)
- `limit`: integer — Page size, max 20 [minimum=1, maximum=20, default=20] (in query)

Response:
- `items`: array of object
  - `id`: integer
  - `customer_id`: integer
  - `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
  - `items`: array of object
    - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
    - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
    - `unit_price`: number
  - `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
  - `created_at`: string
- `next_cursor`: string — Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null on the last page

Creates an order for a customer. Every SKU must exist in the product catalog; prices are taken from the catalog.

Request body (JSON):
- `customer_id`: integer (required) — ID of an existing customer (look it up by email first)
- `items`: array of object (required)
  - `sku`: string (required) — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer (required) — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`

Response:
- `id`: integer
- `customer_id`: integer
- `status`: `pending` | `paid` | `shipped` | `cancelled`
- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string

- `items`: array of object
  - `sku`: string — Product SKU, must exist in the product catalog
  - `qty`: integer — Quantity, at least 1 [minimum=1.0]
  - `unit_price`: number
- `total`: number — Sum of qty * unit_price over items
- `created_at`: string
